description: OOPNET reads and edits EPANET INP files, runs hydraulic models and returns results as Python data objects with plotting support. This resource is provided by oopnet (repository owner). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: MIT. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The README warns that pre-1.0 interfaces are unstable. Linux and macOS require a separately installed EPANET executable. For simulation, it can support model preparation or execution. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
